name: Companion
description: Pets, familiars, and small traveling creatures

fields.description: tracks familiar scents, guards sleepers, and distrusts one apparently harmless NPC.
excellent at finding hidden vermin, warm places, and unattended food.
reliably returns to one chosen home carrying a very small message.

traits: Homing Instinct — Can always determine the direction of a home it has occupied for at least one week.

fields.description: carries modest supplies, eats almost anything, and refuses obviously cursed paths.
squeezes through tiny spaces and learns simple object-based instructions.
loudly challenges strangers, invisible creatures, and anyone carrying bread.

traits: Warning Call — Allies able to hear the call gain +1 to Initiative against a threat the creature has detected.

fields.description: retrieves small loose objects and hides them in inconvenient places.
dependable transport with excellent footing and absolute veto power over unsafe bridges.
emits gentle light and becomes silent when predators are nearby.

traits: Luminous Plumage — Sheds gentle light in a 5-meter radius and can extinguish or restore it at will.

fields.description: provides warmth, lights dry tinder, and sleeps inside cookware.
slowly grows common medicinal herbs across its shell.

traits: Medicinal Garden — Once per day, produces enough common herbs to grant +1 to one healing action.

fields.description: remembers voices and can repeat several short phrases with alarming accuracy.

traits: Perfect Mimicry — Can reproduce any short phrase or familiar voice it has heard clearly.

fields.description: harmlessly dissolves dirt, spoiled food, and occasionally important paper.

traits: Cleansing Ooze — Can dissolve dirt and spoiled organic matter without harming healthy living tissue.

fields.description: records one hour of sound and plays it back when wound.

traits: Sound Replay — Can record up to one hour of nearby sound and reproduce it exactly once before recording again.

fields.description: changes color with the weather and glides short distances between people.
navigates complete darkness and returns when called with a specific whistle.
swims, retrieves floating objects, and insists on opening shellfish during serious scenes.
fiercely guards a single backpack and hunts insects with dramatic dives.
teleports a few meters when startled but rarely chooses the safest direction.

traits: Short Blink — Once per turn when startled or attacked, may teleport up to 3 meters to an open space it can see.

fields.description: folds itself flat, carries written notes, and breathes enough flame to seal wax.

traits: Fold Flat — Can flatten itself enough to pass through a gap as narrow as a sheet of paper.
Wax Flame — Can breathe a tiny flame sufficient to light tinder or seal wax, but not to deal damage.

fields.description: passes through thin walls and becomes visible after eating cheese.
a floating canine made of mist that can briefly conceal a person's face.

traits: Mist Veil — Once per scene, creates a 2-meter cloud that conceals one creature until the start of its next turn.

fields.description: a fist-sized stone creature able to sense nearby tunnels and worked masonry.

traits: Masonry Sense — +2 to Perception actions made to locate tunnels, cavities, or weaknesses in worked stone.

fields.description: absorbs weak magical residue and glows in the presence of active enchantments.
A territorial bird trainable to recognize people, emblems, and routes.

traits: Keen Sight — +2 to Perception actions that rely on vision at long range.

fields.description: a tiny animated suit of armor searching for a person large enough to be its squire.

traits: Animated Armor — Does not need to eat, drink, breathe, or sleep.

fields.description: A trained mount accustomed to carrying a rider along roads and open terrain.
A small, steady mount suited to light riders, pack work, and narrow trails.
A patient pack animal valued for endurance, caution, and secure footing.
A desert mount and pack animal able to travel long distances with little water.

traits: Desert Endurance — +2 to Constitution actions made to endure ordinary heat, thirst, or long desert travel.

fields.description: A quiet nocturnal bird trained to scout, hunt pests, or carry very small objects.
An observant corvid able to learn routines, recognize faces, and imitate simple sounds.

traits: Clever Forager — +2 to Perception actions made to locate hidden food or small unattended objects.

fields.description: A colorful social bird that learns familiar voices and short spoken phrases.

traits: Perfect Mimicry — Can reproduce any short phrase or familiar voice it has heard clearly.

fields.description: A small amphibian companion comfortable in damp ground, ponds, and packs.
